title: "EPRTR Atlas"
subtitle: "European industrial pollutant releases, hazard, population and permits, 2007–2024"

The European Pollutant Release and Transfer Register (E-PRTR) records what
industrial facilities report releasing to air and water. This atlas joins those
reports with a hazard screening of every reported substance, the 2021 census
population around each site, and the IED permit record. It is built to answer
eight questions about industrial pollution in Europe — and to be explicit about
what the data cannot say.

{{< include data/tables/headline.md >}}

## What makes this different

- **Mass is not toxicity.** The largest reported mass is carbon dioxide; the
  largest *classified* mass is carbon monoxide from steel works; the largest
  *carcinogenic* mass is a phthalate discharge from one wastewater plant. The
  atlas keeps the three rankings separate and shows how little they overlap.
- **Hazard is not exposure.** A facility can report a lot and sit in a field, or
  report little and sit in a city. Population within 3 km is a separate layer,
  not a weight applied to the mass.
- **Missing is not zero.** Where the census grid has no cells, the atlas says so
  instead of printing "0 people". Permit coverage is reported per country, not
  assumed.

## Read this first

::: {.callout-warning}
This is a screening atlas, not a risk assessment and not a compliance verdict.
A dark circle means "this facility reported substances that appear on a hazard
list", not "this facility is dangerous". A missing permit record in the EEA
table is not evidence that a facility operates without a permit.
:::

- Release masses are self-reported by operators under the E-PRTR Regulation.
- Permit records cover **2017–2024** only, and only **64.6 %** of the 32,155
  facilities could be linked; Norway, Serbia and Switzerland have no records in
  the table at all.
- Population is a **2021** model on 100 m cells, covering the EU-27 plus Norway
  and Switzerland. The United Kingdom, Serbia, Iceland and overseas territories
  are outside the grid.
- The latest reporting year is **2024**; it may still be revised upstream.

## Data

| Layer | Source | Coverage |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Air and water releases | EEA IED/E-PRTR v16 (2007–2024) | 32,155 facilities, 32 countries |
| Hazard screening | IARC, CLP, ECHA SVHC, EPA HAP, WFD priority lists | 94 E-PRTR labels |
| Population | JRC-ESTAT census grid 2021, 100 m | EU-27 + NO + CH |
| Permits | EEA IED installations table F6_1 | 2017–2024, 20,788 facilities |
| Municipalities | GISCO LAU 2024 (EPSG:3035) | 27,574 facilities joined |
